seo_description: News coverage of Milo’s Cafe in Morrisville, NC: the 2026 News & Observer readers’ poll for Best Sandwich Shop in the Triangle, features, reviews and press contact.
heading: In the
intro: What the Triangle’s food writers have said about Milo’s since we opened on Chapel Hill Rd in 2024.

items.title: Best Sandwich Shop in the Triangle
items.summary: N&O readers voted Milo’s the Triangle’s best sandwich shop. The story goes behind the counter with Menad, the torched-gruyère schnitzel sandwich, and the old motorcycle shop that became the café.

items.title: Best coffee and tea shops in Morrisville
items.summary: Milo’s makes the magazine’s guide to Morrisville coffee shops, called out for its crepes and focaccia sandwiches.

items.title: A cozy spot for fall coffee
items.summary: The local newsletter picks Milo’s for a fall breakfast or coffee with friends, for its specialty coffee, pastries and sandwiches.

contact_text: Writing about Milo’s, or want to come by with a camera? Get in touch and we’ll set a time.
